# Vendor Onboarding

Defines the checks required before FLOW commits money, shares data, grants access, or depends operationally on a vendor.

## Intake fields
Vendor legal identity, service/business owner, purpose, pricing, contract/terms, data accessed, systems integrated, privileged access, hosting/data location, subprocessors, security evidence, privacy/DPA requirement, payment/tax information, auto-renewal, support contacts, and exit/export requirements.

## Workflow
```text
Need → alternatives/selection → commercial review → legal terms → security/privacy review according to risk → finance/tax/budget review → approval → contract/order → account/integration setup → access limited → vendor register + renewal calendar
```

## Completion gate
Onboarding is incomplete if the service is already processing production/confidential data but contract, security review, DPA/subprocessor register, owner, or exit plan is missing.
